title: REQ · Retry limit and budget boundaries are proven by unit tests
summary: MaxRetries 0, unlimited budget and the exact-budget boundary behave as documented
description: Context: run loops while attempt <= MaxRetries and stops with ErrBudgetExceeded only when spent > MaxBudget with MaxBudget > 0. Desired behavior: MaxRetries 0 runs once; MaxBudget 0 never stops early; spend equal to the budget does not stop. Why: prevents runaway agent cost and silent extra attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Given MaxRetries 0 and a failing agent, When Run is called, Then the agent ran once, Attempt is 1 and the error is not ErrBudgetExceeded
Given MaxBudget 0, cost 100 per call and MaxRetries 2 with all calls failing, When Run is called, Then the agent ran three times and the error is not ErrBudgetExceeded
Given cost 2.5, MaxBudget 5.0 and MaxRetries 2 with all calls failing, When Run is called, Then the agent ran three times because spend equal to budget is not exceeded

in_scope: Retry loop and budget check in run

definition_of_done: Retry and budget boundary tests pass
